answers.core:
Right now SoftBody3D has purely decorative utility. This idea would open it to other interactive usage. Add-ons cannot solve this as they have no exposure to the internals of SoftBody3D

This proposal might be considered together with other restructuring the Physics parts in future versions.
answers.workaround: The current prototype workaround with RB is just an idea. Seemingly, the internal mesh is also not directly exposed. If the local transforms of `get_point_transform` are somewhat useful, this might be a possible workaround together with other physics primitives.
